cohort: A total of 483 consenting consecutive healthy newborns were screened at the post-delivery ward and NICU outpatient department of Korle-Bu Teaching Hospital (KBTH).
finding: The incidence of hearing loss among newborns was 7.2%, but there was no statistically significant association of hearing loss between babies admitted to NICU and Non-NICU babies (p=0.728).
mod_finding: Vacuum delivery was mentioned as one of the main reasons for NICU admission, though its association with hearing loss was not directly analyzed.
cross-section timing: Newborns were screened up to 4 weeks or more after birth, with a mean age of approximately 3.8-3.9 weeks.
birth_weight: Babies with macrosomia (from diabetic mothers), big baby, and small baby were included as reasons for NICU admission.
gest_age: Prematurity was identified as a reason for NICU admission.
